prerequisites: Teoría de estructuras e instalaciones industriales

learning_outcomes.text: Discuss Spanish and European regulations applicable to this type of structures.
Deepen conceptual aspects of metallic structure design.
Gain an overview of metallic structures and their applications in civil and industrial construction.
Knowledge and use of the principles of strength of materials.
Knowledge and skills to apply the fundamentals of elasticity and strength of materials to the behavior of real solids.
Knowledge and ability for the calculation and design of structures and industrial constructions.
Knowledge in basic and technological subjects, that qualifies them for learning new methods and theories, and provides versatility to adapt to new situations.
Ability to solve problems with initiative, decision-making, creativity, critical reasoning and to communicate and transmit knowledge, abilities and skills in the field of Industrial Engineering.
Knowledge for carrying out measurements, calculations, valuations, appraisals, expert opinions, studies, reports, work plans and other similar tasks.
Ability to handle specifications, regulations and mandatory standards.
Ability to work in a multilingual and multidisciplinary environment.
Knowledge, understanding and ability to apply the necessary legislation in the exercise of the profession of Industrial Technical Engineer.
Is able to design and calculate and project steel structures.
Knows in detail the resistant mechanisms in steel structures under different types of solicitation.
Knows in detail the concepts related to structural safety.
Is able to define singular constructive details.
Manages national and European regulations on steel structures, with full knowledge of their application limits.

teaching_methods: Practical classes with professional software applications
Development of an individualized industrial building project

assessment_methods.method: Oral defense of a course project (continuous evaluation path)
Structural calculation exercise using software (global evaluation path)

assessment_rules: There are two evaluation paths: continuous evaluation and global evaluation. For continuous evaluation, the final grade is based on a theoretical-practical exam (30%) and the oral defense of a course project (70%); a minimum score of 5 out of 10 is required for the exam. For global evaluation, the final grade consists of a theoretical exam (40%) and a structural calculation exercise using software (60%); a minimum score of 5 out of 10 is required for the exam. The submission of the modeling from practical classes has no weight in the final grade.
